test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Six persons - A, B, C, D, E, and F - are sitting in two rows, three in each, facing each other.

A faces D.

B is to the left of A.

F faces the person who is to the right of B.

C does not face F

Who faces C?
solution:
Given:

A faces D.

B is to the left of A.

F faces the person who is to the right of B.

C does not face F

Here we have 2 cases,

Case 1

Case 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93e569c9ddb4c550735b07120ee855cc3a879a9589d7dae44eff3200b1503fe5.png] 

Thus, from both cases, B faces C.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
